verdict.rationale: Insomnia's core client is Apache-2.0 open source and can run without the vendor cloud: Local Vault storage, Git Sync to any third-party repo, and a no-login Scratch Pad keep data on user-controlled infrastructure. Self-hosted mock servers are explicitly documented via Insomnia Mockbin. However, no self-hosted deployment is documented for the collaboration backend (organizations, RBAC, Cloud Sync). missing for 10: documented self-hosted deployment of the full product including org/collaboration/RBAC services, explicit self-hosting guide for the core, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.
Your project data stays in your repository. Insomnia does not host or manage it.
Users can deploy self-hosted mock servers using Insomnia Mockbin.
You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync
